name: Delete Secret
description: Delete one whole secret from your store under crud/delete on s/NAME. Destructive: use only on explicit user intent, identify the exact credential, and explain that integrations referencing it may stop working. Do not delete secrets as speculative cleanup. This removes Covia's stored copy; it does not revoke the credential at its provider. Missing names return deleted:false.

name.description: Exact single secret name, not an s/ path or wildcard.
